item.title: U.S. Department Of Education approves Louisiana’s Education Flexibility Waiver
item.description: (BATON ROUGE, LA) – The U.S. Department of Education (ED) has approved Louisiana’s application for the federal Education Flexibility Program (Ed-Flex).
